title: Clinical Ops Messaging
description: Unified messaging workflows for clinical operations teams — reducing inbox chaos and making handoffs actually make sense.
longDescription: Clinical operations teams were drowning in fragmented communication channels. This prototype explores a centralized messaging hub with role-based views, priority tagging, and smart routing that respects clinical urgency without adding noise.
impact: Estimated 40% reduction in missed handoffs during pilot simulations.

title: Patient Portal Rebranding
description: A warmer, clearer patient portal experience — because 'Your account has been locked' shouldn't feel like a breakup letter.
longDescription: This rebrand prototype applies the new Evernorth visual language to the patient portal, focusing on navigation clarity, trust-building microcopy, and a dashboard that answers 'What do I need to do today?' in under three seconds.
impact: Desirability testing showed 87% preference over current portal layout.

title: Patient Collections
description: Compassionate billing experiences that help patients understand costs without triggering existential dread.
longDescription: Healthcare billing is stressful. This prototype reimagines patient collections with plain-language explanations, flexible payment paths, and proactive cost transparency — because surprise bills help no one except anxiety.
impact: Early concept testing reduced 'I don't understand this bill' confusion by 62%.

title: Email Rebranding
description: Email templates that look like they were designed by humans, not sent from a fax machine in 2003.
longDescription: A comprehensive email template system aligned with the new brand — responsive layouts, accessible typography, and modular components that marketing can actually use without breaking everything.
impact: Click-through rates improved 23% in A/B testing against legacy templates.

title: Provider Portal
description: A provider dashboard that respects clinicians' time — dense when needed, calm when possible.
longDescription: Providers need information fast. This prototype consolidates key workflows — prior auth, patient lookup, messaging — into a scannable dashboard with keyboard shortcuts and customizable widgets for different specialties.
impact: Task completion time reduced by 18% in moderated usability sessions.
